title: Coles Group Investigates Cybersecurity Incident
excerpt: Australian retail giant Coles Group is looking into a recent cybersecurity incident that has not affected its physical store operations.
body_html:
Coles Group Limited, the second-largest retailer in Australia, has announced it is currently investigating a cybersecurity incident.

According to the company, the security event has not caused any disruptions to its retail stores.

Further details regarding the nature of the incident or potential data impacts have not yet been disclosed as the investigation continues.
